A25 and B11 mandatory M3/trend/interaction fits are recomputed; supplemental scopes are Overall only, Table2 includes smoking strata, Table3 includes both age strata

Laboratory-dependent Table1 means/SE/tests and primary forests are regenerated; unchanged M1/M2 numeric rows, lean objects and non-laboratory descriptions are reused with explicit source hashes and row provenance

followup_conditions: Successful computation is not numerical acceptance. Exact executed-code, copied-plan, derived-data and result hashes must be audited after the run.

Copied M1/M2 lean objects retain their E1 data version; artifact dependencies and row sidecars are authoritative for their unchanged-input reuse in E2.
